name: full-stack-agent
postCreateCommand: git config --global user.name "${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME:-claude-agent}" && git config --global user.email "${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL:-agent@example.com}" && git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace && (gh auth status || echo 'NOTE: GH_TOKEN is not set/valid yet — fill in .devcontainer/.env')
